intro
This is SEND. A place to talk, play and share, together.
profiles
Your profile isn't just a card any more. Pick an effect, and it comes alive the moment someone opens it.
catalogue
There are four hundred and thirty-two bundles, in eighteen collections. Red storms and fairy lights. Liquid platinum. Clockwork. Eclipses.
store
Open Profile Effects, tap any bundle to try it on your own card, and save when you love it. You can even mix one bundle's effect with another's avatar decoration.
decos
Your avatar decoration follows you everywhere. In chat, in calls, and in every member list.
studio
SEND Studio restyles the whole app. Themes, glass, wallpapers and layouts. Give every server, and every conversation, a look of its own.
share
Share your screen in HD, up to ten-eighty p at sixty frames, with sound. And SEND keeps its own audio out of the stream, so nobody hears themselves back.
calls
Pop any call out into its own window, and drag the tiles wherever you like. AI noise suppression removes keyboards, fans and barking dogs, before anyone hears them.
world
Voice runs on servers around the world. On Windows, you can share just your game's audio. And 7TV and BTTV emotes work everywhere you type.
sparks
Then there's Sparks. Complete challenges, like inviting three friends, joining a call with five people, or going live, and each one earns a hundred Sparks.
boosts
A hundred Sparks buys a Server Boost. Each boost lasts a full year, and there are enough challenges to take a server all the way to Level Three. Every year, a new season of challenges.
free
No paywalls. No upgrades. Every feature, for everyone. SEND is completely free.
sponsor
If you'd like to show your support, and help keep it that way, you can sponsor SEND from one pound a month. It's entirely optional, and it keeps the servers running for everyone.
end
SEND. Download it for Windows, or open it in your browser.
